analysis_md:
由 $\begin{cases}\sqrt{x^2+y^2}=z\\z=\sqrt{1-x^2-y^2}\end{cases}$，则 $\begin{cases}x^2+y^2=\frac{1}{2}\\z=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\end{cases}$，于是 $\begin{cases}0\leq\theta\leq 2\pi\\0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{4}\\0\leq r\leq 1\end{cases}$

原式 $=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^1r\cos\varphi\cdot r^3\sin\varphi\,dr=2\pi\cdot\frac{1}{5}\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin\varphi\cos\varphi\,d\varphi$

$=\frac{2\pi}{5}\cdot\frac{\sin^2\varphi}{2}\big|_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}=\frac{\pi}{10}$。
